item.title: Using Jev to Answer the Internet's Hardest Questions
item.description:
Last Thursday I was at a Figma AI event, How AI Built This with Figma. I’m going to write up the event properly later, but one of the demos was showing off how Figma used Jev - TypeSafe’s model that answers questions with typed outputs and probabilities rather than generated text - and somebody made a joke about how we could finally figure out what colour that dress was.

Inspired by that, I have decided it’s finally time to answer each of the internet’s hardest questions.
